description: 3-touch DM sequence for faceless content creator outreach

touches.subject: Quick value share
touches.template: Hey {name}, saw your content on {platform} — really resonated with the {topic} angle. I've been building a system that automates the whole faceless video workflow (research → script → voice → post). Happy to share the framework if you're interested. No pitch, just useful.

touches.subject: Quick follow-up
touches.template: Hey {name} — following up from earlier. Dropped a new breakdown on {topic} that's been getting solid retention. Wanted to share it in case it's helpful for your next post. Let me know if you want the template.

touches.subject: Last message
touches.template: Hey {name}, last message — totally understand if the timing isn't right. If you ever want to swap notes on {topic} automation or the faceless creator workflow, I'm around. Best of luck with the channel.
